commands: set -eu; git fetch origin; git checkout main; git pull --ff-only origin main; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c67752483b07ba88399c6e1e6940c33dd3a2f51f"; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo DEVICE_MODEL=$MODEL; test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21); export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug; APK=$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*debug*.apk' -type f | head -1); test -n "$APK"; adb install -r "$APK"; echo INSTALLED_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

set -eu; TMP=$(mktemp -d); cleanup(){ rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; snapshot(){ P=$1; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$TMP/$P.db"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-wal > "$TMP/$P.db-wal" 2>/dev/null || true; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-shm > "$TMP/$P.db-shm" 2>/dev/null || true; }; snapshot pre; PRE=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/pre.db" 'select coalesce(max(timestamp),0) from signal_samples;'); echo PRE_MAX_TS=$PRE; STARTED=0; if ! adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'io.blueeye.service.ScannerService'; then adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 3; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-window.xml >/dev/null; adb pull /sdcard/tracker-window.xml "$TMP/window.xml" >/dev/null; COORD=$(python3 -c 'import re,sys; s=open(sys.argv[1]).read(); m=re.search(r"content-desc=\"Scan\"[^>]*bounds=\"\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\"",s) or re.search(r"bounds=\"\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\"[^>]*content-desc=\"Scan\"",s); print(f"{(int(m.group(1))+int(m.group(3)))//2} {(int(m.group(2))+int(m.group(4)))//2}" if m else "")' "$TMP/window.xml"); test -n "$COORD"; adb shell input tap $COORD; sleep 5; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'io.blueeye.service.ScannerService'; STARTED=1; fi; echo SCANNER_STARTED_BY_TASK=$STARTED; sleep 180; snapshot post; POST=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/post.db" 'select coalesce(max(timestamp),0) from signal_samples;'); echo POST_MAX_TS=$POST; test "$POST" -gt "$PRE"; echo NEW_SIGNAL_SAMPLES=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/post.db" "select count(*) from signal_samples where timestamp>$PRE;"); echo TARGET_SIGNAL_ROWS; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/post.db" "select coalesce(deviceName,'') as name,coalesce(deviceType,'') as type,coalesce(vendorName,'') as vendor,coalesce(beaconType,'') as beacon,count(*) as samples,round(avg(rssi),1) as avgRssi,max(timestamp) as lastTs from signal_samples where timestamp>$PRE and (lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%fmdn%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%gfps%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%wf-1000xm5%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%garmin%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%forerunner%' or lower(coalesce(beaconType,'')) like '%find hub%' or lower(coalesce(serviceDataByUuidHex,'')) like '%feaa%' or lower(coalesce(serviceDataByUuidHex,'')) like '%fe2c%' or manufacturerId=135) group by name,type,vendor,beacon order by samples desc limit 80;"; echo TARGET_DEVICE_ROWS; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/post.db" "select coalesce(lastDeviceName,'') as name,deviceType as type,coalesce(vendorName,'') as vendor,coalesce(predictedModel,'') as model,coalesce(beaconType,'') as beacon,trackingStatus as status,round(followingScore,1) as score,lastRssi as rssi,lastSeenAt from devices where lastSeenAt>$PRE and (lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%fmdn%' or lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%gfps%' or lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%wf-1000xm5%' or lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%garmin%' or lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%forerunner%' or lower(coalesce(beaconType,'')) like '%find hub%' or manufacturerId=135) order by lastSeenAt desc limit 80;"; echo RECENT_TOP_NAMES; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/post.db" "select coalesce(deviceName,'') as name,coalesce(deviceType,'') as type,coalesce(beaconType,'') as beacon,count(*) as samples,round(avg(rssi),1) as avgRssi from signal_samples where timestamp>$PRE group by name,type,beacon order by samples desc limit 30;"; if [ "$STARTED" = 1 ]; then adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-window.xml >/dev/null; adb pull /sdcard/tracker-window.xml "$TMP/window2.xml" >/dev/null; COORD2=$(python3 -c 'import re,sys; s=open(sys.argv[1]).read(); m=re.search(r"content-desc=\"Scan\"[^>]*bounds=\"\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\"",s) or re.search(r"bounds=\"\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\"[^>]*content-desc=\"Scan\"",s); print(f"{(int(m.group(1))+int(m.group(3)))//2} {(int(m.group(2))+int(m.group(4)))//2}" if m else "")' "$TMP/window2.xml"); if [ -n "$COORD2" ]; then adb shell input tap $COORD2 || true; fi; fi

set -eu; echo SERVICE_AFTER_TEST; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -E 'io.blueeye.service.ScannerService|ServiceRecord' | head -20 || true; echo APP_ERRORS; adb logcat -d -t 4000 | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|io.blueeye.*(Exception|Error)|BleScanHandler.*Error' | tail -80 || true
